title: Reflect academy panel
description: A big 896×640 panel with 24px corners, dark at the top and lit from its floor by a violet glow that turns pale lilac at the bottom edge, with a centred badge, two-line gradient heading, short lead and dark button set inside it; a row of small key caps with labels sits under the panel on desktop. The panel fades in as it enters the window. On phones the panel runs edge to edge with the text at its top.
notes: media fills the panel (a playable game canvas in the original); empty, the floor glow alone
